definitions.explanation: The act of separating or being separated from something. Used in scientific, political, medical, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {政教|せいきょう}{分離|ぶんり}は{重要|じゅうよう}な{原則|げんそく}だ。
examples.english: Separation of church and state is an important principle.

examples.japanese: {混合物|こんごうぶつ}を{成分|せいぶん}ごとに{分離|ぶんり}する。
examples.english: Separate the mixture into its individual components.

examples.japanese: ロケットの{第一段|だいいちだん}が{分離|ぶんり}して、{第二段|だいにだん}エンジンが{点火|てんか}した。
examples.english: The first stage of the rocket separated and the second-stage engine ignited.

notes:
A versatile formal term used across many fields. As a する verb: {分離|ぶんり}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{政教|せいきょう}{分離|ぶんり} (separation of church and state)
・{分離|ぶんり}{独立|どくりつ} (secession, separatist independence)
・{分離|ぶんり}{手術|しゅじゅつ} (separation surgery)
・{分離|ぶんり}する (to separate, to isolate)
